faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)
faq.question_1: How can I create a digital wedding invitation?
faq.answer_1: Simply select a template and personalize it with your details — no design experience or technical skills required. Our platform makes it easy for anyone to create a beautiful digital invitation.
faq.question_2: How are digital wedding invitations delivered?
faq.answer_2: Once created, you can send your invitation via email, share it through social media, or even generate a QR code to include in physical save-the-date cards for traditional guests.
faq.question_3: What types of invitation templates do you offer?
faq.answer_3: We provide a wide selection of elegant templates to suit every style, from classic and timeless to contemporary and minimalist designs.
faq.question_4: Is full customization of invitations possible?
faq.answer_4: Absolutely. You can personalize all text, upload your own photos, embed a wedding video, and even integrate interactive maps to your venue—every element can be tailored to reflect your unique story.
faq.question_5: Do I need to print digital invitations?
faq.answer_5: Digital invitations are designed for eco-friendly online sharing, but we do provide high-quality PDF options if you'd like to print them as keepsakes or for guests who prefer physical copies.
